info.title: Enterprise Forms Platform Console (Development/Testing)
info.description: Backend-for-frontend of the separately deployed Platform Console (PG-070 Operator approvals). Cookie session + CSRF; the signed-in Platform Operator is always the session's. Not part of the business API.

get.summary: The synthetic Platform Operators this development console can sign in (Development/Testing only).

post.summary: Signs in one configured synthetic operator after the Authority confirms it is active and its registered key is its own configured key.

get.summary: The current session, re-validated against the Authority registry (a suspended or removed operator's session ends here).

post.summary: Ends the session on the server (a copied cookie stops working) and deletes the cookie.

get.summary: The signed-in operator's registry entry, platform permissions and the platform journal state.
Cross-organization approval queue (15 per page by default, at most 50; opaque cursor bound to the operator and filter).
Request details, the exact statement and its fingerprint, recorded approvals and eligibility. A sensitive disclosure: the Authority audits each view (fail closed).
Pending approval status (approvals recorded of required) and whether the signed-in operator can approve now.

post.summary: The signed-in operator's approval. First valid approval: AwaitingSecondApproval. A valid approval by a second, different operator: Approved (the Authority creates the membership).
Withdraws the signed-in operator's own pending approval (never another operator's).
Rejects the request with a justification; any pending approval is invalidated and nothing is granted.

get.summary: PG-072: organizations with lifecycle and owner, Security Administrator and member counts (15 per page by default, at most 50).
PG-072 details: owner identities, counts and onboarding provenance. The Authority audits each view (fail closed).
PG-074 queue: onboarding requests, newest first (15 per page by default), and the owner issuers this environment accepts.

post.summary: PG-073: create an immutable onboarding request (dryRun validates only). Creating grants nothing; approvals carry each operator's own evidence.

get.summary: PG-074: the request, its frozen statement and fingerprint, owners, approvals, key custody status, activation and the operator's eligibility.

post.summary: The signed-in operator's approval. The second valid approval by a different operator approves the request (key custody follows).
Withdraws the signed-in operator's own approval.
Rejects a request awaiting approval; nothing is created.
Cancels an approved request before initialization; nothing is created.
Creates the organization, its initial owners and owner roles in one Authority transaction after verifying the custody key; usable once the first change is projected and anchored.
